nom: ANUA Heartleaf Quercetinol Pore Deep Cleansing Foam

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone oily skin report the cleanser removes excess oil, unclogs pores, and does not leave skin feeling tight or over-dried, though a few note it can be too drying without a follow-up moisturizer.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe mixed results: several find it hydrating and non-stripping, but others report it as somewhat harsh, drying, or flaking their skin, especially with frequent use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers frequently pair it with the Anua oil cleanser and report smaller-looking pores, reduced oil in the T-zone, and skin that feels clean but not dried out.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many say it doesn't irritate them and even calms redness or rosacea-prone skin, while others report burning, hives, welts, or allergic-type reactions and had to stop use.
segments.normal: A few reviewers with unspecified/normal skin simply report smooth, soft, clean skin after use with no adverse effects mentioned.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 40s reports the product works well alongside her teenage daughter's use, describing it as effective on both mature and younger skin.

concerns.aging: Only one reviewer references an older age group (40s) and reports satisfaction with results, but no specific anti-aging effect is described.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not strip or dry their skin and even leaves it feeling hydrated, but a notable minority report dryness, tightness, flakiness, or peeling, particularly with daily or excessive use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or general redness give mixed reports: some say it calms redness and reduces breakouts-related redness, while at least one reports a rosacea flare-up with tightness and peeling around the mouth and nose.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer explicitly warns that daily use of the exfoliating formula can damage the skin barrier and cause breakouts if overused; others report no barrier issues even with regular use.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report reduced red spots, clearer skin, and less visible congestion after continued use, with no dissent specific to spots noted.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and calmer active blemishes; however, multiple reviewers report the opposite — new or worsened breakouts, cystic-type acne, or fungal acne after use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers consistently report reduced excess oil and a balanced, non-greasy after-feel, with no dissenting reports on this specific point.

extraits.titre: I would not BUY THIS EVER IN MY LIFE
extraits.texte: This gave me fungal acne my skin was clear and perfectly fine until my friend recommended me this face wash and IT GAVE ME HORRIBLE FUNGUL ACNE and I can't get rid of it now.

I was looking for a new face wash and thought I'd try this one from Anua after hearing great reviews from family/ online. Unfortunately, after trying it out for about a month, my rosacea and skin have flared up around my non-oily part of my face. I like the smell and the texture but when I rinse off, you can feel how tight my skin feels and it is so bad it's peeling around my mouth and nose. For now, I am no longer using this and my skin has adjusted back a bit. I don't have sensitive skin, but this product does not love me!

I foams up well. Leaves my skin clean and soft. It's supposed to be gentle enough to use every day. It exfoliates your skin, which is good. However, you're only supposed to do that once maybe twice a week. It can possible damage your skin barrier and cause major breakouts. You need something a lot more gentle for everyday use.
The formula is a little harsh if you have dry skin but just use a good moisturizer. It dries out pimples and prevents them from coming back. Smells good. Lather is nice. 9/10

extraits.titre: I would buy this product again and again
extraits.texte: I love this cleanser! It helps with redness as I have rosecea. Bi love the texture of this cleanser and it leaves my skin feeling dewy and fresh. Everyone I've recommended it to loves it as well I have dry sensitive skin with a tendency to breakout. One of my favorite products, especially for the price

This is my 2nd Anua product in the last 2 months. Ive got acne prone, oily skin and it's not always easy to find a cleanser that gets all of the gunk and makeup out of my face but doesnt have my skin feeling all tight afterwards. I double-cleanse still, out of habit, but my skin is already clean feeling after the first wash. Wasn't fond of the smell at first, but it's really grown on me the last 3 weeks. Highly recommend!

I debated the brand but now I can't imagine not using this cleanser and the cleansing oil. It's a great duo! I have sensitive skin, tends to be on dry side, and I have some redness. These products have not irritated me or caused breakouts.
